title: Define common Gallery GPU renderer contract
scope: Replace the Metal-shaped GPU renderer boundary with backend-neutral device, buffer, synchronization, target and optional diagnostic-readback contracts.
acceptance: A mock renderer consumes public native-interoperability records and rejects foreign devices, stale buffers and unsafe ownership transitions.
Shared graphics shader inputs and draw semantics cover every current Gallery domain without embedding physics equations.
evidence: PASS: cmake --build build-desktop-switch -j1; 96 build steps; GCC/Linux host

PASS: ./build-desktop-switch/parallel-mater-gallery-gpu-renderer-contract-tests; mock rejects foreign devices/targets, stale resource/frame generations, and unsafe/overlapping ownership; tests/gallery/gpu_renderer_contract_tests.cpp
PASS: slangc gallery.slang vertex+fragment -target spirv -profile glsl_460; Slang 2026.18; explicit Vulkan bindings and shared named draw inputs
